title: Everything looks blurry
backstory: The picture used to be razor sharp. Now it looks soft all over, like the resolution has dropped. Turning the focus pot on the flyback doesn't help much.
visible_effect: Lua overlay adds a vignette darkening at the edges and a soft overall tint; CRT preview shows weak_focus shader
diagnosis_hint: Persistent soft focus that doesn't respond to the focus pot almost always means the focus voltage from the flyback transformer is sagging. Measure the focus pin with a high-voltage probe — should be around 4–6 kV. Low voltage means either the flyback itself or the HV divider network is failing.
